question.text: Securities Lending and Borrowing Scheme of Clearing Corporation is:

explanation.text: The Logic: The Securities Lending and Borrowing (SLB) Scheme of the Clearing Corporation is explicitly kept outside the interoperability framework. The Trap: Assuming all clearing activities are covered by interoperability — the source places SLB outside this framework. Note: Knowing which segments are excluded from interoperability is as important as knowing what is included.
